label: Chunky gradient
note: W6 and W11 together: the chunky rounded lowercase from W6, filled with the theme-colour-to-pink fade from W11.

label: Chunky + mascot "o"
note: The W6 lowercase with the mascot standing in for the first "o", sized to the letters, feet hanging below the line.

label: Gradient + mascot "o"
note: The same mascot "o", with every letter in the colour fade, so the mascot pops out as the only solid shape.

label: Glossy, like the mascot
note: Rounded Fredoka letters with the mascot as the "o" and a shiny top highlight that matches the shine on the app icon's mascot.

label: Toy-block 3D
note: Fat Lilita One letters with a deep 3D edge underneath, like a plastic toy or a game logo.

label: Sticker edge
note: Chunky lowercase with a thick white sticker border and soft shadow, so it pops on any wallpaper.

label: Wallpaper inside the letters
note: The letters are cut out of your theme's own wallpaper, so the name literally wears your theme.

label: Bouncy
note: Grandstander letters that hop slightly up and down, playful like the mascot waving.

label: Clean + mascot "o"
note: The closest to today's site: Nunito capitals, colour fade on "You", mascot as the "o". The grown-up version.

label: Soft two-tone
note: Sniglet: the roundest, softest letters, "you" in the theme colour with a gentle shine, "coded" in the text colour.

label: Cartoon
note: Chewy, a hand-drawn cartoon font, in the colour fade: the most playful option.

label: Two mascots
note: Both "o"s are mascots, one in "you" and one in "coded". Fun, but busier and harder to read small.
